body.name: Hazard-lift cohort functional
body.construction: For \(z_0,\ldots,z_r\in\mathcal Y\), define \(\pi^0_{g,r}(z_0,\ldots,z_r)=\bar\alpha\bar K_0^gL\bar B_{z_0}P_{\mathrm{dk}}\bar B_{z_1}\cdots P_{\mathrm{dk}}\bar B_{z_r}\bar v/p_g\), and define \(\mu^0_{g,r}=\bar\alpha\bar K_0^gLP_{\mathrm{dk}}^rE\bar v/p_g\).
